title: fix: APK download broken after build produces `app-release-signed.apk` instead of `NutriPlan.apk`
body:
The latest build workflow created release `v-202604302331` with the APK uploaded as `app-release-signed.apk`. Since this release is newer than `apk-latest`, `releases/latest/download/NutriPlan.apk` now resolves to the wrong release — no file with that name exists there, breaking all download links.

## Changes

- **`build-apk.yml`** — copy the built APK to `NutriPlan.apk` before passing it to `gh release create`, ensuring every release asset is consistently named:
  ```sh
  cp "$APK_FILE" NutriPlan.apk
  gh release create "$TAG" NutriPlan.apk --title "NutriPlan Build $TAG" ...
  ```

- **`profile.html`** — replace the dead `https://biocode.website/NutriPlan.apk` href (file was never served from the site) with the canonical `https://github.com/Radilovk/aidiet/releases/latest/download/NutriPlan.apk` URL, consistent with `index.html`.
